name: iBabs besluiten to decidesk Decisions
description: Reads besluiten for a vergadering from the iBabs RIS source and writes them into decidesk's Decision OpenRegister objects (decisionType=motion). {{vergaderingId}} is supplied per run; targetId is decidesk's register/schema id pair (fill in per instance: <decideskRegisterId>/<decisionSchemaId>).
